title: ladder_stage: one lit 3D object carries every number, as The Ladder draws it
goal:
Krish, 11 Nov 2026: "yes port The Ladder and The Living Screen into ve"; he chose "Cards for Codex" for the build. Port The Ladder (lab/styles/ladder/STYLE.md and scene.mjs, the approved lab build) into one STAGE device, `ladder_stage`, built after card ve-style-0-three-and-moves. One persistent object across the STAGE beats that name it; every number is a change to the object.

1. `params`: `object` ('branch' first: the stucco branch with a 5x4 window grid; the kind is a param so a career ladder or a receipt can follow), `parts` (how many countable parts, default 20), `copies` (how many objects can drop into the street, default 3), `towers?` ({left: n, right: n} slabs), `labels?` (short label per act). Numbers come from `dataset`, each with its producer credit; text only from params and the dataset.
2. `enter`: the object rises into its set, camera craned in on the hero curve (1.1 s).
3. `count_to` with `toState` = n: parts light one by one to n in about 0.6 s, landing on the spoken word; counting down, the leavers go dark in 0.07 s steps (moves count-on-a-part).
4. `add` with `toState` = k: k copies drop into the street with weight (move street-drop).
5. `draw`: the mint level line draws across the ground under the street (move level-line).
6. `move` with `toState` = 'branch' | 'street' | 'towers': the camera cranes to that act in 1.1 s; between moves it drifts (never rests).
7. `fill` with `toState` = {left, right}: the two towers of slabs fall away or grow (move slab-towers).
8. `highlight` with `toState` = 'left' | 'right' | part index: that part or tower turns mint.
9. `carry`: one slab lifts off, turns mint and makes four (move task-copies-3d).
10. `exit`: the set falls to ink.

Look: soft shadows, ACES filmic, bloom only on lit glass, fog to ink, the house paper texture on stucco and slabs, tokens only. Tall: the object fills the screen below the type, which starts under the channels' top bar (y 270); nothing that must be read right of x 860 or below y 1320 (config/channel-safe-zones.json). Wide: object centre right, type top left.

## Tests (`device.test.ts`, stills from `fixture.json`)
- nothing before `enter`; after `count_to` 20 exactly 20 parts lit, after `count_to` 13 exactly 13
- `add` 3 puts three copies in the street; `draw` shows the level line; `fill` sets tower heights
- the same frame twice renders identical pixels; no colour outside tokens
- tall and wide stills render, and the tall still's lit parts sit inside x 60 to 860 above y 1320

## After it builds (Claude, not Codex)
`ve verify-card`, then `ve lab render` and `ve lab diff` (the house look unchanged), then a fixture render of the house test take in this style sent to Krish for Gate 2. On his yes, Claude takes `needs_device` out of the `ladder` entry's `ve_route` in config/style-references.json (a guarded file: his yes, in person) and out of `needs_device` in apps/renderer/src/engine/kit/motion-profiles.json, so a spec naming `style.motion: "ladder"` routes to `ladder_stage`.
contract: Device rules: apps/renderer/src/engine/devices/CONTRACT.md. Register in `devices/registry.ts` and `config/ve/devices.json` with exactly enter, count_to, add, draw, move, fill, highlight, carry, exit; update `verbs.test.ts`. Draw with three.js through @remotion/three, from the frame alone. Reuse packages/moves, never copy a move.
acceptance:
npx vitest run apps/renderer/src/engine/devices/ladder_stage
npx vitest run apps/renderer/src/engine/devices/verbs.test.ts
python scripts/ve/check_route.py
